purpose: Teach: かっこう/細長い/薄暗い/スグ/熟睡/退散/公私/この上ない

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新しい髪型かっこうの良いな
lines.en: Riku, your new haircut looks really good on you.
lines.style: Warm observation, genuine smile in the voice. Light and easy, like a casual compliment between friends. No edge—just noticing something good about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、細長いシャープペンお気に入りだったな、桜
lines.en: You were always obsessed with that thin mechanical pencil, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Slightly teasing, but underneath: remembering. Softer than it sounds. Drawing her into the shared memory. A small smile underneath the cool exterior.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、薄暗い教室で勉強してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were always studying in that dark corner of the classroom.
lines.style: Playful observation with an undertone of affection. Light mockery wrapped in recognition. She's not criticizing—she's noticing him, and he knows it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの答えスグに思い出せたな、桜
lines.en: You'd remember test answers before anyone else even finished reading the questions, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine admiration breaking through careful cool. Slight lift on the recognition. This is respect dressed in casual words. A small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、授業中に熟睡してたろ
lines.en: Riku, you'd fall into the deepest sleep in the middle of class.
lines.style: Affectionate exasperation. Slight headshake in the voice. Remembering something that frustrated and delighted her in equal measure. Warmth underneath the wry tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お母さんが来ると即退散だな、桜
lines.en: The second your mom showed up you'd disappear like smoke, wouldn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Knowing smirk in the voice. Calling him out with the gentleness of someone who understands why. Quick, light rhythm. A shared private joke.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、彼女と公私分けてないな
lines.en: Riku, you never could separate your girlfriend from the rest of your life.
lines.style: Wry observation with underlying tenderness. Slight tease—not unkind. Recognizing something about him he probably doesn't fully see. Quiet in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業式の感動はこの上ないだろうな、桜
lines.en: Nothing's going to move you quite like graduation day is going to, Sakura.
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. Softer attack. Recognizing something true and tender about her—something he's held onto. Trailing slightly on the end. Genuine underneath the cool.
